_comment: Platform profiles vendored from the Factory, at the exact version game.config.yaml pins.
A game repository does not contain the Factory, and release validation must judge a build
by the rules that were in force when its plan was approved — validating against the latest
profile instead of the pinned one is named as a failure mode in the Factory's
platform-validation stage. Vendoring makes the game repository self-contained and the
The .yaml files here are byte-identical copies of core/reference/platforms/<id>.yaml, so a
drift is a plain diff. Written by the Factory at scaffolding; do not hand-edit.
Re-pinning to a newer profile version is a release decision, not a maintenance task.
